In [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The New Rebellion]]'' to [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]].</ref> a [[Color/Legends|gray]]-[[Hair/Legends|haired]] '''Gotal''' visited the [[Crystal Jewel]] [[Casino/Legends|casino]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]], and entered into a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] against a [[Brubb]], a [[Ssty]] and a [[Tintinna/Legends|Tin-Tin Dwarf]]. In one hand, the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Gambling/Legends|bet]] all that it owned, betraying its nervousness by shedding piles of hair&mdash;a condition that most Gotals had learned to control. Shortly after the hand, an [[Bombing of the Senate Hall|explosion]] went off in the nearby [[Senate Hall]], which damaged the casino, leading to many of its patrons fleeing the premises.<ref name="TNR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gotal gambler appeared in the [[1996]] novel ''[[The New Rebellion]]'', which was written by [[Kristine Kathryn Rusch]].<ref name="TNR" />
